parse_mlc_output: parse mlc benchmark stdout into a dictionary of latency and bandwidth metrics
parse_idle_numa_latency: parse idle NUMA latency values from mlc benchmark output lines into a metrics dictionary
parse_peak_injection_bandwidth: parse peak injection memory bandwidth values from mlc benchmark output into a metrics dictionary
parse_loaded_latency_with_delays: parse loaded latency and bandwidth metrics keyed by injection delay from mlc output
parse_cache2cache_transfer_latency: parse local and remote socket cache-to-cache transfer latency values from mlc output
